title: Blimey rig (rig.yaml)
description: Fixtures, their DMX addresses and canvas positions, and named groups. Address overlaps, unknown profiles or modes and unknown group members are checked by the engine at load.

fixtures.description: Profiled fixtures, and pixel grids, which have a type.

groups.description: Group name → fixture names. A group name can't also be a fixture name.

profile.description: File name, without .yaml, of a profile in the show's fixtures/ folder.

mode.description: A mode name from the profile, e.g. 16ch.

pixelGrid.description: A generic RGB or RGBW pixel grid; a column is a grid with one column. Pixel cues drive it; looks don't. One universe holds 170 RGB or 128 RGBW pixels; a larger grid continues on the next Art-Net universe.

colour_order.description: Each pixel's emitters in DMX order: R, G and B, and optionally W, once each.

wiring.description: How the chain runs along the rows from the start corner. Defaults to row-by-row.

start_corner.description: Where the first pixel is, as seen from the audience. Defaults to top-left.

universe.description: Art-Net port-address of the first pixel, 0-32767. Only, and required, for output: artnet.

address.description: 1-based DMX start address in that universe.

gridCanvas.description: The rectangle the grid fills on the canvas, bottom-left corner at (x, y).

canvas.description: Position on the normalised stage canvas: a front view, as the audience sees the stage (x 0 stage right, 1 stage left; y 0 the floor, 1 the top). Pixels are spread evenly across width, in pixel order, starting at x.

x.description: 0 at the left edge, 1 at the right edge, as seen from the audience: 0 is stage right, 1 is stage left.

y.description: 0 at the floor, 1 at the top of the stage picture.
